summary: Implemented `cycle-04-connection-notation-canonicalization`. The query canonicalizer now expands standalone, case-insensitive `WW` only for supported catalog-domain queries into `WW приварной под приварку сварной`, preserving the original tender text for retrieval fallback, reranking, and output. Added focused positive/negative canonicalization tests plus hybrid and matcher regression coverage. OpenSpec tasks are marked 5/5 complete and the change validates strictly.
